title: Spectral Visitor at the Door
description: A translucent ghostly figure composed of swirling dark mist and musical notes stands at an open wooden door, one hand touching the frame. Footprints lead across the floor toward the dark interior while a stormy sky filled with swirling vortex clouds and lightning looms above.
prompt: A translucent ghostly silhouette made of swirling dark mist and floating musical notes stands in profile reaching toward an old wooden door that stands open, leading into complete darkness. Black footprints trail across the floor toward the doorway. Above, a turbulent night sky swirls with concentric vortex clouds and streaks of lightning, dramatic surreal atmosphere, moody and haunting.
